title: Fleet Standing of a Host at the Point a Keyturn Vehicle Listing Is Published
content:
1. A host's Keyturn Vehicle Listings are read as one fleet when the marketplace decides what may go live, even though each listing is reviewed on its own.

2. No host holds more listings in a class than that class allows. Listings in the draft, the review, the live, the snoozed and the suspended standings are counted together, since a suspended vehicle still occupies a place in the fleet; only a vehicle that has been taken down for good frees a place.

3. Where a host holds listings in several classes, each class's ceiling is counted on its own, and a place free in one class never makes room in another.

4. A host whose rating has fallen below the minimum of a class they hold may keep the listings already live in that class but may not publish another in it until the rating recovers.

5. Where a host carries an unresolved safety suspension on any vehicle, no further listing of theirs is published until it is resolved, because the fleet is judged as a whole on safety.

### Standing of the evidence

The safety suspension clause is decided before the listing is published, and on the marketplace's own records rather than on what the host says: the standing of each listing the host holds and the ground recorded against any suspended one. The listings are gathered to the host by the member the listings belong to, so the clause reaches every vehicle in that member's fleet and no vehicle of another member.

### Worked reading

A host holds 4 live listings and 1 suspended listing in the Keyturn Standard Class Listing, whose ceiling is 8, and holds 3 listings in the Keyturn Exotic Class Listing, whose ceiling is 3. Their sixth Standard listing is within that class's ceiling, counting the suspended vehicle; a fourth Exotic listing is not, and the free place in the Standard class makes no room for it. Where the suspension on that fifth Standard vehicle is a safety suspension that stands unresolved, no further listing of that host is published at all while it stands.
